tex_content.label: prop:v4-component-contradiction
tex_content.html:
↗ prop:v4-scalar-clock

The transported classes remain nonzero and their actual filling widths satisfy the preceding bound. A component path therefore cannot exist through $B\in [T_1,T_2]$ with $P_{T_1,w(T_1)}(B)<0$.
Proof

The class construction preserves nontriviality and identifies the starting width with the free infimum at $T_1$. Scalar comparison would give $0\leq w(B)\leq P_{T_1,w(T_1)}(B)<0$. This contradicts existence of that path; a common extinction time still requires common initial data.

□
